subject: POC Success Criteria, Cadence & Final Readout — LumenWorks Pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@lumenworks.com>, Alex Barton <alex.b@lumenworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC Success Criteria, Cadence & Final Readout — LumenWorks Pilot

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on what success looks like and how we’ll run the pilot. I captured items we discussed and where we (Redwood) need input from LumenWorks.

Summary of agreed goals (proposed success criteria):
- Functional: Redwood model integration demonstrating 90%+ match rate on the 5 sample intents you provided (intent mapping sheet).
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 450ms for 1kB prompts under the test harness.
- Cost: Token cost at or below the price range we discussed in the deck (we’ll provide profiling during the trial).
- Ops: End-to-end repeatable deployment and a documented rollback path; audit logs available for all test requests.

Cadence & milestones (proposal):
1) Kickoff call: Week of Dec 6 — technical kickoff with LumenWorks infra + Redwood SE (owner: Hannah).
2) Integration window: Dec 7–16 — connectors, test harness, sample dataset ingestion (owner: Jonas).
3) Weekly syncs: every Friday 10:00 PT — short status, blockers, and action item review (owners: Marissa + Priya).
4) Midpoint readout: Dec 20 — preliminary results on functional metrics and latency profiling.
5) Final readout: Jan 5 — validated success criteria, ops checklist, and recommended next steps (owners: Hannah + LumenWorks stakeholders).

Immediate asks for LumenWorks:
- Confirm kickoff attendees and preferred time window for Dec 6–8.
- Share the full sample dataset and intent mapping spreadsheet by EOD Wed Dec 2 (we need stable inputs for evaluation).
- Provide any security/compliance contacts if you’d like Redwood to complete the questionnaire in parallel.

Attachments: REDWOOD_POC_PLAN_v1.pdf (high-level schedule + owners), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (workback calendar + dependencies).

Next steps from our side: I’ll schedule the public calendar invites once you confirm the kickoff slot. Jonas will drop a short integration checklist in the Drive link below. Marissa will host the weekly status board.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
